# JellyFil Journal (jellyfil.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for JellyFil, a once-daily men's vitality gummy marketed to support energy, stamina and everyday drive in adult men. 30 gummies a bottle; one gummy daily with a glass of water. Seller-listed: one 82 mg blend of green tea extract, maca, muira puama, catuaba, horny goat weed, tribulus terrestris, ashwagandha and L-arginine (individual amounts not given) plus 5 mg of natural caffeine. Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus $9.99 shipping, 60 days), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping, 90 days), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping, 180 days); 60-day money-back guarantee.

IMPORTANT: JellyFil is a supplement, not a treatment for erectile dysfunction, low testosterone or any condition. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). L-arginine and horny goat weed may matter with nitrates, blood-pressure and ED medicines; ashwagandha and green tea extract have been linked to liver effects and ashwagandha to thyroid effects; ask a doctor first with heart, liver, thyroid, prostate or hormone-sensitive conditions. For adult men only; not for women or anyone under 18. Seek care for chest pain, fainting, a racing heartbeat or yellow skin.

Not the maker's website and not an authorized distribution portal. Contains affiliate links.
